rationale: Identity verification was done correctly via matching the provided email to a single user. The agent checked order details and product details appropriately and performed the tablet exchange on a pending order after the user explicitly selected a replacement, which aligns with policy. However, there were two policy violations: (1) The agent modified the shipping address for order #W1092119 without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed. The tool call to modify the pending order address occurred before any confirmation from the user. (2) The agent set the user's default shipping address without explicitly asking for confirmation of the change, despite stating intent to do so. While the exchange was handled correctly and final information was supported by tool outputs, the lack of required confirmations before order/profile-changing writes means the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
